predicted_csat.label: Predicted CSAT
predicted_csat.detail: A satisfaction score the system works out from the conversation itself — how the customer sounded at the start and end, whether the issue got solved, and how much effort it took them. It is not a survey score.

avg_csat.label: Average CSAT
avg_csat.formula: average of all predicted CSAT scores
avg_csat.detail: The mean predicted satisfaction score across every conversation that was reviewed.

handoff_rate.label: Handoff rate
handoff_rate.detail: The share of conversations the agent couldn't close on their own and had to pass to another team. This is the number Tata 1mg flagged as too high.

resolution_mix.label: How contacts closed
resolution_mix.detail: Every conversation ends one of four ways — solved, handed off and still pending, cancelled or refunded, or left unresolved. This is the split across all of them.

sentiment_trend.label: Mood: start → end
sentiment_trend.formula: closing mood compared with opening mood
sentiment_trend.detail: Whether the customer felt better, the same, or worse by the end of the conversation than they did at the start.

root_cause_groups.label: Top contact reasons
root_cause_groups.formula: conversations grouped by why the customer got in touch
root_cause_groups.detail: Each conversation is tagged with the real reason behind it, then grouped so you can see which reasons come up most.

agent_scorecard.label: Agent scorecard
agent_scorecard.detail: Every conversation is scored on four things: answer accuracy, empathy & tone, taking ownership, and proactive help. Shown here as the average across all conversations.

accuracy_completeness.label: Answer accuracy
accuracy_completeness.detail: Did the agent give correct, complete information and actually check the order or booking rather than guess.

empathy_tone.label: Empathy & tone
empathy_tone.detail: Did the agent acknowledge the customer's frustration and use warm, human language.

resolution_ownership.label: Took ownership
resolution_ownership.detail: Did the agent drive the issue to a real next step instead of passing it to another team. In this sample it's the clearest thing that separates happy customers from unhappy ones.

proactivity.label: Proactive help
proactivity.detail: Did the agent look ahead — flag a likely follow-up, add a note, or offer extra help before being asked.

repeat_contact_signal.label: Repeat contact
repeat_contact_signal.detail: Flagged when the customer says they've reached out before about the same unresolved problem.

churn_risk.label: Churn risk
churn_risk.detail: How likely this customer is to leave. High if the order was cancelled or refunded, or they ended angry with a low score; Medium if it was handed off and still open; Low otherwise.

journey_gaps.label: Process gaps
journey_gaps.detail: The process, data or visibility problems the conversation exposes — in effect, a to-do list of things to fix so the contact wouldn't happen again.
